profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary: Besides building and creating software, I am also interested in access to computer science for underrepresented students and low-income students.

positions.title: Code2040 Fellow
positions.description: Code2040's flagship program is the summer-long Code2040 Fellows Program, which places high performing Black and Latino/a software engineering students in internships with top tech companies and provides mentorship, leadership training, and network development.

positions.title: Vehicle Billing Manager
positions.description:
-Manage the billing of a 34 passenger bus as well as a 7 passenger van at Pomona College. 
-Python script is used to generate invoices and email them efficiently to the corresponding customer.

positions.title: igniteCS Undergraduate Student Leader
positions.description:
IgniteCS provides funding and resources for groups of college and university students to make a difference in their local communities through CS mentorship.

We have partnered with Colony High School in Ontario, CA. We will be mentoring students in Colony's first programming class in the Fall of 2017 as they begin to learn about programming and game design.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Using RAW LoRaa radio communication, BLE,  and the LoRa's by PyCom internal FTP, developed an IOS application allowing users to send text messages in a 1 mile radius without any cellular service.
